title: Ho Nam — 'It gets to the heart of what I call digging your own grave'
summary: Ho Nam — co-founder and managing director of Altos Ventures, the firm whose early-stage bets include Roblox, Coupang, and Krafton — posts a brief but pointed endorsement on X: he's seen mission-drift happen 'over and over again' and is grateful Incorruptible exists. 3,700 views, 19 likes.
blockquote: Reading a great new book by @ericries which gets to the heart of what I call digging your own grave. It's inexplicable and yet I've seen it happen over and over again. I'm grateful he wrote it. And there is some hope that it's possible to create some rare, incorruptible companies.
attribution_title: Co-founder & Managing Director, Altos Ventures (Roblox, Coupang, Krafton)
